implementationEvidence.finding: The photo/labels are letterboxed from full source dimensions; outside the selected polygons and uncertainty is supervised background.
Materials initialize to unknown 255 and are assigned only inside known selected body.
ForegroundNet receives RGB only; fourth detail channel is forced to zero.
MaterialNet inherits RGB-only foreground input; joint loss includes known-body background penalties.
Real-label loader carries RGB, target and weights; masked loss includes known negatives and excludes uncertainty.
Separate offline automatic SAM prompting derives prompts from predictions. It does not supply a recorded user/instance cue to the current training model.

recommendedProtocol.name: Selected physical heart conditioned on an explicit rough selection box
recommendedProtocol.input: Full RGB photograph plus a separately recorded rough-box raster identifying the intended heart; preserve context or optionally crop with a saved invertible transform. A positive point is required when a box alone does not uniquely select one visible instance.
recommendedProtocol.smallestGeneralImplementationDirection: The foreground decoder already has a fourth detail channel, currently hard-zero. A separately versioned prompted experiment could feed a rough-box channel there while retaining the pretrained RGB stem. Existing checkpoints and studies stay RGB-only; this is a proposal, not an implementation or permission to reclassify results.
recommendedProtocol.promptProvenance: Record image hash, selected instance id, source-pixel rough ROI/point, origin (human/public ROI/automatic proposal), review status, transform and whether target labels were used. Do not silently use exact polygon envelopes or exact overlap corners as test-time prompts. Label-derived jittered training prompts need explicit provenance; held-out inference prompts must be obtained independently.
recommendedProtocol.targets: Selected visible body plus selected image-local paper A/B. Other hearts may be known background only because a usable selection cue is supplied. Preserve all unknown body bands/occlusions, unknown material gaps and unresolved contact centers.
recommendedProtocol.groups: Keep original source, near-duplicate and motif/family grouping. Crops, prompts and augmentations from one photograph never create independent split units. Preserve QA reservation, unassigned status, and unresolved family links.
recommendedProtocol.minimalNoArchitectureAlternative: Restrict inputs to independently chosen crops with exactly one identifiable intended heart. Record the crop transform and selection provenance; reject ambiguous multi-heart crops or request a cue. This restricted task is not full-photo selected-instance segmentation.
recommendedProtocol.rgbOnlyAllHeartAlternative: Annotate every visible basket body or explicitly ignore unreviewed basket regions. For paper identities across multiple hearts use per-instance material identity, not one shared global two-paper exchange. This requires more labels and a different task contract.

limitations: Visual counts describe identifiable photographed basket bodies, not proof that no hidden heart or unrecognizable fragment exists.
Single-heart current images cannot establish how RGB-only models choose among multiple hearts.
Metadata kind=photo alone is not proof of instance count; source images were visually inspected.
Point evidence establishes the recorded label at six verified other-heart interiors, not an exhaustive polygon annotation for those hearts.

parentReview.finding: No current clear multi-heart negative conflict observed. Two separate drafts need an explicit instance selection protocol before admission. This does not explain existing single-heart model failures.
